Mobile · Illustrated narrative · Pick a chapter, then a line

Where that line takes you

Pick a choice — the reachable endings light up.

Why this format fits The Hunt

  • Dreams hear everythingYour own lore states it: in REM the boundary between thought and speech dissolves. So in dream chapters even a thought is heard — by Zalian, and by the machine tapping her. Awake, only spoken lines cross. Same menu, two different physics.
  • Speech is the save state"Clementine will remember that" becomes "Zalian heard that" — a running record of what a god actually knows, which is what every ending is computed from.
  • Silence is a playable moveThe faction ordered Fridan to stay quiet. A player can go whole chapters saying nothing and reach an ending where she never learns she was robbed.
  • Art you already ownEvery scene here is one of your existing plates. A visual-novel frame needs illustration, not animation — which is the one asset class this project is already rich in.
